export_evidence: ImportKey (US customs import records, buyer-side view of Indian shipper), slug /countries/india/ups-scs-india-pvt-ltd — row seen: "2022-11-22 | UPS SCS ( INDIA ) PVT. LTD | DOLLAR TREE DISTRIBUTION INC. | GHERKINS(PICKLED FRUITS AND VEGETABLES) | Chennai, India | USOAK, USA | 990002.0 | MAA20B009C00W". Additional rows actually seen on the same page: 2022-11-19 (destination CAPRR, Canada, BOL MAA20B3BBB00W), 2021-07-16 (USOAK, USA, BOL MAA203000100W), 2021-06-26 (CAPRR, Canada, BOL MAA203933300W), 2020-07-20 (USOAK, USA, BOL MAA303009100W) — 5 dated export rows with BOL numbers, all HS 990002 (US customs low-value/consolidated code, not the declared 847190). Source counter vs rows seen: page header shows no total for this slug; 5 rows rendered, 5 read. Second slug /countries/india/ups-scs-india-private-limited shows a counter "Total Shipments 3536 Records detected", "Trading Partners 42", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28", but those rows are IMPORT lanes into India (e.g. "2026-02-28 | Mellanox Technologies, Ltd | UPS SCS (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED (FOC) | ... | HONG KONG, CHINA | BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India | 85444220 | 7797615") and are NOT counted as export evidence.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract record was retrieved. web_search was unavailable during this run (searx connection refused) and registry pages (zaubacorp, thecompanycheck) returned HTTP 403, so domestic supply could not be checked. Not public in the sources reachable here — recorded as null, not inferred.
note: Role is freight forwarder / logistics arm (UPS Supply Chain Solutions) acting as consolidator and as agent for third-party shippers (e.g. "UPS SCS AS AGENT FOR DOLLAR TREE..."), so the export rows evidence shipments it handled, not goods it manufactured. Declared HS 847190 is not supported by any row seen: the export rows carry US code 990002, while the India import rows on the second slug carry 85444220, 84718000, 85176290, 84717060 — i.e. IT/electronics hardware (NVIDIA/Mellanox, Pure Storage, Ruckus, Super Micro) moving through it, consistent with the claimed industry but not with the specific 6-digit code. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; recommend verdict accepted_hs_corrected with the factual code taken from actual records. Revenue and export volume: null — ImportKey free view gives shipment counts (3536 India import records) but no value figures, and no figures were invented. No sanctions/court angle assessed (out of scope for this role).
